companion.title: Companion Plugin Precision Model Config
companion.notLoaded: Companion plugin (astrbot_plugin_private_companion) not found. Please install and enable it first.
companion.unconfiguredExplain: Unconfigured keys are provider fields supported by the companion plugin but not set yet. Those scenarios either do not need a dedicated model, or fall back to another configured model automatically.
companion.unconfiguredHowto: To make a scenario use a dedicated model, open the companion plugin's config page (Feature Toggles → General Capabilities / Model/Provider → Quick Config) and fill in the matching key; it will then appear here.
companion.usedModelsEmpty: No models are configured in the companion plugin's precision config.
companion.usedModelsCount: {n} models in use (unchanged entries keep their original value)
companion.simpleExplain: Replace by model name: a model is replaced wherever it is used, whether as primary or fallback.
companion.advancedExplain: Replace primary and fallback models separately.
companion.runtimeOutOfSync: The companion plugin still holds the old value in memory; reload it in AstrBot's plugin manager before checking.

detail.allModels: Full list of models in use

companion.overviewExplain: Lists every companion-plugin purpose and its current model. Unconfigured entries can be set directly from the primary/fallback dropdown and saved instantly.

settings.title: Detection Settings
settings.testTimeoutHint: Max wait time for a single model check.
settings.historyRetentionDaysHint: Auto-cleanup history older than this (0 = forever).
settings.tipLine1: Settings are written to the plugin _conf_schema immediately (also visible in AstrBot config UI).
settings.tipLine2: Timeout and retry affect each model's latency and success rate in Test All.
settings.tipLine3: Scheduled checks and alert thresholds will be added here later.
